title: Pathfinder
introDescription: Answer a few questions about your mood and we'll match you with places that fit.
submitConfirmDescription: We'll match your mood to places around Sibolga.
resultsDescription: Based on your answers, this is the traveler you are.

ACN.name: The Explorer
ACN.blurb: You go looking for the unfamiliar, even when it's close at hand. Old quays, hidden reefs, untold stories — you want to be the one who found them.

ACF.name: The Voyager
ACF.blurb: Distance is a feature, not a cost. You set out for the far edge to find what others miss, and the journey is the point.

ASN.name: The Wayfarer
ASN.blurb: You move through the bustle — markets, harbors, fish-sellers at dawn — and the day is shaped by whoever you meet along the way.

ASF.name: The Convoy
ASF.blurb: You round up the crew and set out for the islands. The further the better, as long as the company is good.

RCN.name: The Wanderer
RCN.blurb: Slow steps through old streets, letting every stone and doorway speak. You'd rather understand one place deeply than skim ten.

RCF.name: The Drifter
RCF.blurb: You let the tide carry you somewhere quiet and far, and ask nothing of the day but to pass gently.

RSN.name: The Harbor
RSN.blurb: You find warmth in the local hum — a coffee, a conversation, the waterfront at dusk. Company and comfort, not conquest.

RSF.name: The Retreat
RSF.blurb: You escape with a few close people to somewhere far and still, where the loudest thing is the wind through the trees.
